text:
Maria: Quick sync — PR #1327 is ready to land but we have one tiny naming + format nit. Linter flags `dbUserID` (should be snake_case). Planning to merge in today's 16:00 window. Anyone able to review/approve?
Liam: I'll take a look in ~10m. If it's small I can approve.
Ash: The linter error is in models/user.go around line 42. Rename to `db_user_id` and run `make fmt` should fix. Also spotted trailing whitespace in README.
Maria: Link to failing CI: https://ci.redwood/1327/build/5 — thanks, @Liam @Ash. If no one pushes a patch I'll fix in ~20m.
Liam: LGTM after rename. One nit: prefer the `db_user_id` ordering over `user_db_id` — small but consistent with other fields. :thumbsup:
Sam: Approve from me once CI is green.
ci-bot: CI: fmt check failed — run `gofmt -w .`
Maria: Running fmt and will force-push a tiny fix in 5.
Maria: Pushed fix (`git commit --amend`). CI rerunning: https://ci.redwood/1327/build/6
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅
Liam: Approving now. @Maria go ahead and merge during the 16:00 slot.
Maria: Merging now — thanks all! :rocket:
